description: Mission cleanup rules - remove test aircraft and debug scripts

categories.name: Mission Cleanup
categories.description: Remove test aircraft, debug units, and temporary scripting from missions

rules.name: No Test Aircraft
rules.description: Mission should not contain TEST/FAKE or other placeholder aircraft in flight lineup

rules.name: No Dummy Aircraft
rules.description: Mission should not contain DUMMY or SPAWN units that aren't part of actual flight plan

rules.name: No H1TMAN Aircraft
rules.description: Remove H1TMAN ground units if not required for mission (debug aircraft)

rules.name: No Invalid Spawn Units
rules.description: Mission should not contain invalid or broken spawn configurations
